newsitem.title: USA: FDA verifies STERIS Amsco unit compliance.
newsitem.headline: FDA verifies STERIS Amsco unit compliance.

text.p: STERIS Corp said on Tuesday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has removed its AMSCO International Inc unit from the agency's Application Integrity Policy, where it had been for two years.
STERIS said after it completed its acquisition of AMSCO in May 1996, it cooperated with FDA to resolve all issues that led to the application of the integrity policy to AMSCO.
The FDA told Steris the unit seemed to be in compliance with regulatory requirements and the agency would resume scientific review of any pending or future applications submitted by AMSCO.
FDA had previously suspended its review of all AMSCO pre-market notification submissions as a condition of the Application integrity Policy, the company said.
STERIS was not immediately available to comment further.
STERIS provides infection prevention, contamination control, and surgical support systems, products, services, and technologies to healthcare, scientific, research, and industrial customers.
